national.line: In South Carolina, children's goodbye letters for a senior dog went viral and helped get him adopted.
A tiny black cat found stuck in a car engine brought unexpected joy to a Sandy Springs, Georgia, couple whose wedding anniversary falls on Halloween.
A Knicks fan's hilarious Halloween display featuring Taylor Swift and Timothee Chalamet has gone viral.
Twenty years after dreaming about a house as teenagers, a pair finally made it theirs after slipping a handwritten note under the door.
A retired Oregon couple facing financial hardship was surprised with a new $16,000 heating and cooling system through a 'Feel the Love' program that has helped 3,100 people.
A woman accidentally said 'Love you!' to an important client, and his perfect response even included a heartwarming follow-up email.
A 3,156-pound pumpkin is going for a world record.
Actor Jason Segel married Kayla Radomski in a botanical garden wedding in Pasadena, California, on October 17th.

local.line: Congratulations to the Lebanon R-3 School District, which earned a national Meritorious Budget Award.
Congratulations to an Olathe, Kansas, man who reeled in a world-record 164-pound paddlefish at Lake of the Ozarks on his very first time snagging.
Congratulations to three Lebanon tennis players who received All-District honors.
Congratulations to the Camdenton Lakers, who beat Capital City in a back-and-forth Week 8 football game on a go-ahead touchdown run by Michael Maschino.
Congratulations to the Lebanon High School Marching Yellowjackets, who placed at the Valhalla Marching Festival at Parkview High School in Springfield on October 3rd.
Congratulations to Camdenton's homecoming royalty, part of the town's homecoming celebration that included a parade.
Congratulations to Lebanon Schools on the opening of the new Robert W. Plaster Center for Student Success.
Patrick Mahomes' mom has shot down a story claiming the Chiefs star has a home at Lake of the Ozarks.
Congratulations to Brittany Stamm, the new head girls basketball coach for Lebanon Schools.
Nearly 2,300 boaters turned out for a sunny Fall Harbor Hop at Lake of the Ozarks.
Congratulations to Kalem Copling, the new head boys basketball coach for Lebanon Schools.
A developer is looking to build a new 126-room Hyatt hotel in Backwater Jacks' Cove at Lake of the Ozarks.
A neighboring church stepped in and built a ramp for a Lebanon woman living with a rare condition called Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome, to make her daily life easier.
Lake of the Ozarks set a heat record on Tuesday, October 13th, when the National Weather Service says temperatures reached the low 90s.
Lebanon Schools' Hive Depot is providing essential resources and learning opportunities for Lebanon students.
The Joel E. Barber C-5 School District is considering building a high school addition onto its existing building.
The City of Lebanon has gone back to the drawing board with another new city logo, paired with a new slogan: 'Build your journey here.'

music.line: Ella Langley is celebrating one year of her massive hit 'Choosin' Texas,' saying she is constantly and consistently amazed.
Tim McGraw, Paul Overstreet and the Stanley Brothers are the newest inductees into the Country Music Hall of Fame.
Megan Moroney made country music history at the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show.
Zach Bryan says Morgan Wallen and Jason Isbell helped change his mind about Nashville, and that the chip on his shoulder was his own.
Morgan Wallen, Garth Brooks and Taylor Swift are among the artists with the most weeks at No. 1 on Billboard's Top Country Albums chart.
Trace Adkins is celebrating 30 years of his 'Dreamin' Out Loud' album with its first-ever vinyl release.
Vince Gill and Marty Stuart teamed up on a new album, 'Marty and Me,' that Saving Country Music calls twangy and tasty.
Turnpike Troubadours announced two headlining shows at Red Rocks for 2027, with special guests Amble and Wade Forster.
